description: Angular component for managing map layers in a widget, including form controls, drag-and-drop reordering, validation, and external dependencies.

classes.name: MapLayersComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for map layer settings, supporting drag-and-drop, validation, and form control integration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes to propagate valid layers.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form control value from external data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returning validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: layersFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of layers.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer at specified index.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a new layer with default settings.

methods.name: prepareLayersFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array from a list of layer settings.
